consequence.statement: This is a dependency bump in the repository's documentation tooling (/hack/api-docs). It has no operational consequence for clusters running external-secrets.

assertion.statement: The pinned mkdocs-material version used by the API-docs build tooling in /hack/api-docs was bumped from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11; this is a build-time change to the documentation tooling with no operational effect on deployments.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The bump only affects the docs build tooling in /hack/api-docs. Nothing deployed or configured in a customer environment references it, so there is no environment condition to state.
